search_selection.metric: internal validation macro_F1 at fixed10, max; exact tie -> lower learning rate
search_selection.loss_parameters: fixed as above, no additional loss-weight search
search_selection.seed: one fixed search seed, not selected from results

matrix.calibration: first already-counted pilot; if full matrix exceeds2hours then stop and revise budget, do not silently shorten matrix
matrix.next_layer_arcface: important pending comparator; excluded from first4-method matrix, needs separate registration/budget
matrix.current_implementation: configuration generation and split/cost validation only; full four-objective training runner must be prepared and tested in the separately authorized B1 execution before fitting

projection_after_first.formula: first_seconds +1.8*first_seconds*(15+16*2*1.25); stop before remainder if exceeds7200s

batch_rng: NumPy default_rng(seed), per-group shuffle each epoch, then shuffle group order for each batch; saved schedule generated once per stage/fold/seed, reused all methods and LR

group_dro.update: q=normalize(q*exp(eta*group mean CE)); loss=sum(q_detached*group mean CE)

supcon.positives: same TX except self, one view per packet, includes all across-RX positives

source_internal_selection: fixed10 macro-F1, exact rational confusion-derived macro-F1 tie -> lower learning rate; no outer RX read during search
formal_final: fixed20; no validation choice or early stopping; final evaluation only after fit
statistical_unit_note: two formal seeds, two paired fitted folds, shared-model RX correlated; no packet pseudorep p-values

comparison.main: each nonCE method vs same-fold same-seed Strict CE; all cells and all90edges
comparison.primary_descriptive_support: report Pareto comparison of pooled/each-seed RX-balanced Accuracy, macro-F1 and minimum RXxTX Recall; separately count >=10pp candidate-versus-CE losses in all paired cells. An observed pooled joint improvement requires no pooled Accuracy decrease and a higher global minimum Recall; mixed seeds or new severe losses remain explicit limits, not algorithm GO.
comparison.strong_method_sufficiency: Do not claim GroupDRO/GRL/SupCon/IB fully solve or fail universally; B1 has fixed coefficients and finite source-internal LR search, no independent dataset
